description: This file defines a command handler class for updating savings account charges within the Fineract project. It implements command processing logic by invoking the corresponding service and is annotated for dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: UpdateSavingsAccountChargeCommandHandler

methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.
